_schema.ingredientBenefits: {catalog_key: {benefits: [benefitId], why: one short sentence naming the nutrient, minGrams: grams of that ingredient per serving needed to count it (spices 1-3), tags?: [fermented|legume|whole_grain|omega3|vitamin_c|dairy|egg|soy|plant|vegetable|fruit|spice|prebiotic]}}. Keys are canonical keys from ingredients.json (resolve recipe keys through key_aliases.json first).
_schema.rules[]: {id, when, benefits: [benefitId], weight: int (ranking weight, 2 = stronger), why: template ({fiber}, {protein}, {count} are filled in), note?}. 'when' conditions are ANDed, all per serving: fiber_g, protein_g, sugar_g, kcal, proteinPer100kcal, satFatShare (optional) as {op: value} with op in >=, <=; hasTag: tag (any non-optional ingredient with that tag over its minGrams); allTags: [tag] (each present); tagGrams: {tag: {op: grams}} (summed grams of tagged ingredients); distinctPlantTagged: {op: n} (count of distinct ingredients tagged 'plant' over minGrams).
_schema.scoring: Recipe score per benefit = sum of rule weights + 1 per contributing ingredient. Show at most 4 chips, highest score first.
